checks: Slow first status read shows checking in settings and compact card, aria-busy, no reconnect/OAuth action.
First ok:true unknown/backend_not_ready status and failed RPC both offer retry without reconnect or a confirmation time; recovery restores account and ToolView keeps quiet feedback.

Actual Host contract envelope shape (mocked RPC) ok:true with unknown/service_unavailable or unknown/backend_not_ready preserves the prior account DOM, connected state and confirmed time while exposing refreshError; no reconnect is offered.
Manual refresh and a simulated timeout result retain the same account DOM; stale/error notice is visible, recovery clears it and updates last-confirmed time; dark 360px layout fits.
Window focus and the 15-second scheduled refresh retain the connected account while reads are pending.

Definitive Host results replace a previously connected account immediately for expiry, identity mismatch, enterprise/application permission, unknown/revocation_failed, unknown/org_policy_denied and unlink.
DWS unlinked / robot connected and DWS connected / robot offline are rendered independently, with no implicit authorization.
Personal configuration fields align and fit mobile, successful configure clears secret, pending login retains continue/cancel, stop hosting and reconfigure remain available.
Enterprise connection sends no configuration fields; robot read error preserves its own last state and recovery clears the error without affecting DWS.
Keyboard activation opens unlink confirmation with safe initial focus; Escape preserves binding and restores focus; confirmed DWS disconnect leaves robot state independent.
User-started DWS authorization and cancel use the same Store while remaining independent from robot authentication.
Unmount/dispose stops status and robot polling; zero browser errors and zero external requests.
limitations: Standalone React harness, not the assembled DSH Web/Desktop shell.
RPC, account data, robot configuration and OAuth pages are synthetic; no real DingTalk, Connector, robot or server was contacted.
Unit/Host tests cover callback-origin trust, transaction/source guards and request races separately.
